purpose: #198: the LRM 12.31.3 analog callbacks in ESPice's transient: acbInitialStep runs, an acbConvergenceTest rejection backs the step up instead of ending the run, and an acbAbsTime off the step grid forces a solution at its time and fires there

oracle.derivation: vpi_gain.c's $espice_scaled(2.0) is 2*scale and the device is I = 2*scale*V/1k under 1 kohm from 1 V, so v(out) = 1/(1 + 2*scale). scale is 0 at the operating point (v(out) = 1 at t = 0), 1 from acbInitialStep (v(out) = 1/3), and 2 from the acbAbsTime at 0.37 ms (v(out) = 1/5), which is 3 (1/7) had no acbConvergenceTest been asked. A host that never lands on 0.37 ms never fires it, and v(out) stays 1/3; one that ignores acbInitialStep stays at 1 until then.
